name: The Abyssal War
author: Tristan
description: The Threat does not stay in the abyss. Once woken, the fabricator swarms colonize the sector's fringe - founding real colonies that mine, refine, and forge for a closed hive economy - then strike outward at inhabited space, converging on the core worlds. Fight the network, not just the fleets: cut its supply chains, sabotage expeditions in fabrication, and lay siege to the entrenched hives - land a persistent ground front of marines and heavy armaments, take the hive stratum by stratum, and destroy the Fabrication Core at its center - eradication is a ground victory, not a timer. Standalone; pairs with Remnant Retribution. Configurable via LunaLib (optional).
